currentScientificFindings.claim: In the frozen v5.1 synthetic model, mediation provides a positive relational delta while delay under deficit produces worsening health and accumulated harm.

With delivery failures disabled, all 40 lower-urgency cells favor mediation and all 120 higher-urgency cells favor visibility; every baseline lower-urgency visible exception is a mediated-delivery failure.
Removing urgency changes 105 of 160 matched winners; shortening persistence changes 32; removing the relational mechanism changes 33; removing identity changes zero.

Delay changes relational outcomes through endogenous threshold-crossing paths even when direct relational coefficients are fixed; the preregistered separability claim failed in 620 adjacent comparisons.
Threshold location controls which trajectories are exposed; gain scale controls effect magnitude; material 40 is not a uniquely privileged boundary.
An exact local execution found complete persistence and sign preservation under widths 1, 2 and 4, with active contrasts broadening from 304 to 328, 360 and 424 and no reversals.

Under both hard and width-2 smooth transitions, learning alone reproduces all 304 and 360 active relational delay contrasts and their full magnitudes; health alone and the learning-health interaction contribute zero.

Identity salience is decision-relevant inside the authored model: changing salience from 0 to 1 changes 87 of 640 response-grid classifications and monotonically increases mediated-minus-visible relational and overall margins in every cell.
